decisions.reason: Conferencing is cheap to keep alongside the voice business, but Teams and Zoom have commoditised it and it shows no traction, so it is kept with a high chance of being dropped.
Data centre adoption confirms the value of this infrastructure-based connection network, which fits the high-bandwidth strategy and justifies further commitment.
Optical spectrum runs on owned fibre and meets growing high-bandwidth demand, so keeping it costs little and its upside remains attractive.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service in Germany, but it still earns revenue on existing infrastructure at low cost, so it is kept for now with a substantial chance of being dropped.
Direct voice connection is core to the enterprise voice and SIP migration business and cheap to run on the owned network, so there is no reason to abandon it.
